history_full:
Pawl Din Tan Dan

Sihphir Kohhran Pavalai Pawl hi kum 2013, February 23 (Inrinni)-a Kohhran Committee meeting-in Social Front Committee atanga rawtna, 'Pavalai Pawl din ve ni rawh se,' tih chu tha tiin, Pavalai Pawl chu din tan a ni a. A din ni pawh February ni 23, 2013 (Inrinni) hi ni nghal tura ngaih a ni bawk.

Pawl din tirh atangin Kohhran rawngbawlna kawng hrang hrangah pavalai te an tel ve theihna tur leh an thiamna, chakna leh theihna te Kohhran leh khawtlang tana an hman tangkai theihna turin hma lak a ni.

Pawl din tirh hruaitute chu Upa Lianzamlova (Chairman), Pu C. Lalremruata (Vice Chairman), Pu H. Lalrinthanga (Secretary), Pu Lalchungnunga (Assistant Secretary), Pu H. Lalthanzuala (Treasurer) leh Pu HV Zaliana (Financial Secretary) te an ni.

Pawl Rawngbawlna leh A Tum

Sihphir Kohhran Pavalai Pawl chuan Kohhran rawngbawlna peng hrang hrangah Kohhran Committee leh Bialtu Pastor te thawhpuiin hma a la thin a, Pawl hian member-te inpumkhatna, inlaichinna leh thlarau lam nun tihchak bakah Kohhran mamawh phuhrukna, Kohhran inkhawm leh programme hrang hrang tihhlawhtlinna kawngah pawh a theih ang tawkin thawh a tum thin.

INRELBAWLNA LAM

  1. Hruaitu (Office Bearer) thlan: Chairman leh Secretary emaw, Chairman chauh emaw pawh hi Kohhran Committee-in tul/tha a tih chuan a ruat thei a. Kum 2018 thleng kha chuan Chairman leh Secretary-te hi Kohhran Committee-in a ruat thin a; post dang zawng chu Member kalkhawmin Secret ballot-in an thlang thin. Tin, kum 2018-a Synod-in Inkaihhruaina mumal tak a siam hnuah phei chuan, mi pakhatin chanvo (post) ngai kum hnih (2) chin chelh thei tura a ruahman angin kalpui zui a ni.
  2. Committee Member ruat: Hruaitu (Office Bearer) thlan zawhah OB-te leh Bialtu Pastor leh inthlanpui tura Kohhranin a ruatte nen an thawhpui tur tul an tih zat Committee Member an ruat nghal thin a. Chungte chuan Committee neih hun turte an ruat nghal thin. Kan Kohhranah chuan kan din tirh kum 2/1 bak chu thla tinin committee hun bik ruatin committee neih thin a nia, hma lakna turte relin kum tluanin Hruaitu bik pawh hriat loh khawpin taima takin kan rel ang angte thawkin hma kan la ho thin.
  3. Member lak: Inkaihhruainain a sawi angin, kum tinin Committee Member-te kan Kohhran mite inah lutin member nih duhte an zawtin an lakhawm thin. Member hi 140-170 bawr vel an ni tlangpui a. Chet velna (activities) hrang hranga che vel chu 20-40 bawr te an ni thin bawk.
  4. Sum tuak chungchang: Pawl a din chuan sum mamawhna a lo awm a, member tinte huapin thla tinin ‘Pavalai Thawhlawm’ tih vuahin Committee Member bial vawngten kan remchan ang kan thawhte an lakhawm thin a. Thla khatah ₹ 3,000/- atanga ₹ 8,000/- bawr vel chu a tling khawm thei thin.

INKHAWM LEH INPAWLKHAWMNA LAM

A. Inkhawm: Sihphir Kohhran Pavalai Pawl-te hi din a nih kum (2013) atanga kum khat leh thla hnihna vel (May 8, 2014, Ningani) thleng kha chuan Kohhran Hall leh mimal inah te inkhawmin Hruaitu hmasaten khaihlak awm lovin an lo chhawm nung zel tiha lang a, an fakawm hle a ni. Hun a lo kal zel a, May 15, 2014 Kohhran Committee remtihnain Biak Ina inkhawm leh dar vuak te, thuhril nana pulpit hmante a remchan hnuah a nal mumal deuhva inkhawm theih a lo ni ta a.
        Committee-in inkhawm programme atana a ruahman, heng - Sermon, Short sermon, Veizawng sawi, Hla sak, Hla thlan, Bible chhiar rual etc. te hmang hian hun hman a ni thin.
         Biak Ina inkhawm a nih atang chuan Office Bearer-ten a thla biin emaw, inkhawm apiang emawin an inhruai chhawk thin. Hun tam zawkah chuan Office Bearer leh Ex. Officio bakah Committee Member zing atangin mi 3-6 vel thusawi tur ruat chhuaka sawi thin a ni. Kum tira ruat lawk loh kum, Hunruattute kuta dah kumte pawh a awm bawk. Short sermon hi neih tura rel loh kum a awm a. Neih tura rel kum chuan Committee Member zing atangin a sawi thei awm ruat thin a ni.
        Tantu/Thawhlawm khawntu/Zai hruaitu atan chuan a ti thei awmte ruat chhuah a ni ber.

B. Inpawlkhawm: Biak In ni lova inkhawm/inpawlkhawmah chuan Item hrang hrang - Solo, Group zai, Debate, Quiz - Bible & General Knowledge, Extempore Speech etc. leh Inpawlkhawmnaa tih atana tha kan hriat apiangte tih nan hun hman thin a ni.

C. Member's Meet: Mihring kan nih chhungin thil pakhata insawrbringa inhmuam up te hi kan lo peih reng lo va. Chu chu kan sakhuana rilruah pawh hian ken tel chang a awm a tul thin. Biak In lama kan hman loh ang deuh va inthihphur tul nia hriat changtein, awmni khama hun hlimawm leh boruak zangkhai zawk neiha, chawhlui han kilho te tul kan tih changin Kohhran Centenary Hall/Biak In Vestry-ah te neih thin a ni a.
             Sport item hmangtea bul tan duh tumin Outdoor programme siamin hun hman a ni a. Indoor programme te hman chhunzawmin, kan Bial chhunga Bial leh Tualchhung KPP Hruaitute sawm leh, kan Represent-te chanvo pawimawh pein, hlim takin member 30-40 bawr vel laiten kan hmang thin.
